targets.rawSql:
WITH GatewayLocations AS (
  -- Grab the most recent known GPS coordinate for every gateway
  SELECT 
    node_id::text AS node_id, 
    MAX(latitude) AS lat, 
    MAX(longitude) AS lon
  FROM position_metrics
  WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL 
    AND longitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY node_id
)

SELECT
  m1.packet_id::text AS "Packet ID",
  
  -- The Origin Gateway (Heard the early version of the packet)
  COALESCE(n1.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || m1.reporting_gateway || ')') AS "From Gateway",
  m1.reporting_gateway::text AS "Raw From Node ID",
  
  -- The Destination Gateway (Heard the rebroadcasted version later)
  COALESCE(n2.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || m2.reporting_gateway || ')') AS "To Gateway",
  m2.reporting_gateway::text AS "Raw To Node ID",
  
  -- THE NEW METRIC: Exactly how many times did it route?
  (m1.hop_limit - m2.hop_limit) AS "Hops",
  
  -- The Latency
  (m2.rx_time - m1.rx_time) AS "Latency (Sec)",
  
  -- The Math: Haversine Distance in Miles
  ROUND(
    (3959.0 * acos(
      LEAST(GREATEST(
        cos(radians(loc1.lat)) * cos(radians(loc2.lat)) * cos(radians(loc2.lon) - radians(loc1.lon)) + 
        sin(radians(loc1.lat)) * sin(radians(loc2.lat))
      , -1.0), 1.0)
    ))::numeric, 2
  ) AS "Distance (Miles)",
  
  -- The Final Metric: Speed (Miles per Second)
  ROUND(
    (
      (3959.0 * acos(LEAST(GREATEST(cos(radians(loc1.lat)) * cos(radians(loc2.lat)) * cos(radians(loc2.lon) - radians(loc1.lon)) + sin(radians(loc1.lat)) * sin(radians(loc2.lat)), -1.0), 1.0)))
      / NULLIF((m2.rx_time - m1.rx_time), 0)
    )::numeric, 3
  ) AS "Speed (Mi/s)"

-- The Self-Join: Match the exact same packet heard by two different gateways
FROM mesh_packet_metrics m1
JOIN mesh_packet_metrics m2 
  ON m1.packet_id = m2.packet_id 
  AND m1.reporting_gateway != m2.reporting_gateway 
  
  -- Ensure m1 is the gateway that heard it FIRST
  AND m1.rx_time < m2.rx_time
  
-- Attach the node names for readability
LEFT JOIN node_details n1 ON m1.reporting_gateway::text = n1.node_id::text
LEFT JOIN node_details n2 ON m2.reporting_gateway::text = n2.node_id::text

-- Attach the GPS coordinates from our CTE
JOIN GatewayLocations loc1 ON m1.reporting_gateway::text = loc1.node_id
JOIN GatewayLocations loc2 ON m2.reporting_gateway::text = loc2.node_id

WHERE $__timeFilter(m1.time)

  -- THE HOP FILTER: Prove it physically traveled across the mesh
  AND m1.hop_limit IS NOT NULL 
  AND m2.hop_limit IS NOT NULL
  AND (m1.hop_limit - m2.hop_limit) >= 2
  
  -- THE CO-LOCATION FILTER: Ignore gateways sitting on the exact same desk
  AND ROUND(loc1.lat::numeric, 4) != ROUND(loc2.lat::numeric, 4)

ORDER BY "Distance (Miles)" DESC
LIMIT 20;
